name: spendwise-expense-tracker
description: Full-Stack Multi-User Expense Tracker Web Application

scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync('npm install && npx vite build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
